description: Centrifuge modeling of vertical differential settlement-induced cracking in a levee is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Olaniyi Afolayan, Auburn University (auburn.edu). A centrifuge test (ODA01) was used as a proof-of-concept test to investigate the effect of vertical differential settlement on crack formation in a model levee. The Yolo loam embankment levee and its foundation were 250 mm and 62.5 mm high in prototype scale, respectively. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Cracking, Concentrated leak erosion, Levee, Centrifuge test, Differential settlement. Published 2024-07-01. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 3-Clause BSD License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
